intro_en: HealthBench Hard is a 1,000-example difficult subset selected from HealthBench's 5,000 conversations. Construction first removes the roughly 1.5% of examples on which every selection model scores zero, then takes the 1,000 lowest average HealthBench scores across five model providers. The original conversations, physician rubrics, and official scoring formula remain unchanged.
scale_en: 1,000 difficult conversations selected from 5,000 HealthBench conversations
metric_en: Model-graded Physician Rubric Score, Clipped Mean, Bootstrap Standard Error

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.08775, Appendix C, and the official openai/simple-evals HealthBench Hard loader. The authors compute each full-set HealthBench score for o3, Grok 3, Gemini 2.5 Pro (March 2025), Claude 3.7 Sonnet with extended thinking, and Llama 4 Maverick. They first remove examples on which no model earns positive points, approximately 1.5% of the 5,000-example full set, to avoid selecting items dominated by excessive difficulty or rubric variability. They then rank the remaining examples by average score across model providers and select the lowest 1,000; provider averaging avoids making the split adversarial to one model family. No new conversations or rubrics are authored. Evaluation preserves HealthBench's signed physician-authored criteria, binary model-grader decisions, per-example normalization by maximum positive points, clipped aggregate mean, bootstrap uncertainty, and behavioral-axis slices.
